text: According to Damasio's somatic marker hypothesis, patients with damage to the ventromedial prefrontal cortex can retain largely normal intellectual function while showing severely impaired practical decision-making.
explanation: True. Damage that disrupts access to somatic markers (bodily signals tagged to past outcomes) preserves reasoning tests yet cripples real-world choice, which Damasio takes as evidence that bodily states are constitutive of rational decision-making rather than peripheral to it. This directly supports the body-as-mind thesis.
